articles.title: Fake building: Claude wrote 3k lines instead of import pywikibot
articles.summary: An individual tasked an advanced AI model, Claude Code Opus 4.7, with fixing typos on Fandom wikis. Intriguingly, the AI reportedly generated approximately 3,000 lines of code to accomplish this task. This anecdote highlights the current development approach of AI models in programming, often leading to extensive code generation even for seemingly simple problems, offering insights into AI's practical application.

articles.title: Iran deploys mini subs in Hormuz, escalating US naval standoff
articles.summary: Market predictions show declining confidence (from 42% to 35.5%) that Strait of Hormuz traffic will normalize by end of June. Another prediction involves 20 ships transiting daily by May 31. This indicates financial market speculation regarding shipping activity and stability in the vital Strait, a key global chokepoint.

articles.title: Army gets DRDO-developed kamikaze drone & UAV-launched precision munition systems from Adani Defence
articles.summary: The Indian Army has significantly boosted its defence capabilities by acquiring advanced systems. These include DRDO-developed kamikaze drones and UAV-launched precision munition systems, supplied by Adani Defence. This strategic acquisition enhances the Army's operational precision, provides critical indigenous loitering munition capabilities, and is crucial for modern warfare scenarios, thereby strengthening national security and self-reliance in defence technology.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine trade blame for continued fighting as US-brokered ceasefire nears its end
articles.summary: A US-brokered 72-hour ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine faced expiry on Monday, with both sides levelling accusations of breaches. This critical development underscores the deep-seated mistrust and persistent conflict dynamics in the region. American and European officials are actively deliberating future strategies, highlighting international efforts amidst the ongoing geopolitical tensions.
